user.title: Oticat Energy
user.description: Connects to the Oticat Energy service. Add each inverter afterwards with its own site token.

approve.title: Oticat Energy
approve.description:
This Home Assistant found {entities} entities and {inverters} inverters that a site could use. A site on dom.oti.cat chooses which of them it reads and drives, but only among the ones you allow here.

Ticking an entity allows the service to use it for a site.

What leaves for each:

- **Battery level**: its current value.
- **Energy meter**: its last 14 days of hourly energy.
- **Power sensor**: its current value.
- **Switch or climate**: the hours it was on, and the ability to switch it.
- **Direction sensor**: its current state.
- **Zone**: its coordinates and name.

Anything not ticked is refused, and the site's card says why.

If you continue you will see the list, with everything ticked, and can untick what you do not want. If you decline, the integration loads but reads and drives nothing until you allow entities in Configure.

user.title: Inverter
user.description: Everything about this site is set on dom.oti.cat, in Energy management: the battery, the solar panels, the grid contract, the high-consumption devices, and which entities in this Home Assistant it reads and drives. This side only needs the site's token, and it reports back what it has so the page can offer it.
